sdk/registry.ts: defineTool typed from the zod input (expectTypeOf in test/registry.test.ts, checked by tsc); effect classes read|reversible(inverse)|irreversible(mitigation)|mitigation are mutually exclusive by type (@ts-expect-error) and at runtime (throws); toAiTool produces an ai@7 tool whose JSON schema matches the zod schema and whose execute delegates; ToolRegistry. sdk/recorder.ts + R3 in queries.ts: one statement per action (counter, Action, READ, Effects + Entity state, UNDOES, DEPENDS_ON to the latest earlier done writer, weight 1, via read|write). test/recorder.test.ts on bt:test: read-after-write, write-after-write, latest-writer-only (one edge, no parallel edges), cross-run/cross-agent, seq monotonic with edges pointing backwards, single statement + action.recorded parsed by the RunEvent schema, pending→commit, NEXT chaining. Gates green.

graph/queries.ts: Q1–Q7, Q12–Q14 are typed functions with answers: lines returning QueryResult; test/queries.test.ts builds the golden demo graph through the recorder on bt:test and asserts each (Q1 depth 1/2/3 reveals apply_credit at 3 hops with its via path; depth clamp; Q2 seq DESC; Q3 counts; Q4 the three lock-ins; Q5 scope; Q6 reads/writers/effects/deps; Q7 billing agent only at depth 3; Q12; Q13 by action/entity with dates; Q14 later writers and a human edit). pnpm gen:queries writes graph/queries.cypher and a test fails if it is stale.

sdk/undo.ts planUndo = resolve_action → Q1 → Q2 → Q3 → Q7 → persisted plan (P1). test/undo.test.ts on bt:test (golden graph): plan (six steps seq DESC with labels, mitigation for send_email, blast 6/1, cross-agent billing apply_credit at 3 hops, reload from graph equal), depth 1 subset, none (read-only), unknown (3 candidates; ambiguous text), memory (already undone → prior plan with status and date). Gates green.

sdk/undo.ts executeUndo: undo Run by agent backtrack, per step in plan order Q14 verdict → inverse restore or mitigation → recorded with UNDOES (originals undone), REVERTS/COULD_NOT_REVERT/CONFLICT edges, paceMs hook, undo.step/undo.finished events. Tests: order + world restored + edge counts; human edit → CONFLICT edge + partial; too-shallow plan → conflict; undo-the-undo refused; re-running an executed plan is a no-op. Gates green.

sdk/gate.ts: Q5 policies (block → denied, confirm → user-approval, warn → note) then Q4 lock-in on the pending action; reason text built from rows; (User)-[:APPROVED|DENIED]->(Action) via idempotent R7; waitForDecision polls the graph. sdk/run.ts runTool wires it into recording. Tests: test/gate.test.ts (3 reversible upstream → user-approval 'would lock in 3 reversible changes: update_address, create_ticket, post_message'), test/run.test.ts (done, approve, deny, block). Gates green.

Q8 algo.pageRank, Q9 algo.betweenness, Q10 algo.wcc, Q11 algo.SPpaths (weightProp weight, relDirection incoming, spike extended and docs/spike-results.md updated) in queries.ts. test/algorithms.test.ts on the golden graph asserts shapes and values: PageRank order update_address > create_ticket > post_message; post_message top betweenness, leaves 0; clusters [8,1]; path update_address→create_ticket→post_message→apply_credit with weight 3, no path backwards. Gates green.

Q15 (q15PlanEntities) returns the state of every entity a plan touches, including entities its compensations create; diffStates turns live vs fork rows into field-level changes. Covered by test/rehearse.test.ts (diff contains ord_1001.address back to the seed and the new draft eml_2). Gates green.

sdk/rehearse.ts rehearseUndo: GRAPH.COPY to bt:<tenant>:fork:<planId>, executeUndo on the fork, Q15 on live and fork, plan marked rehearsed, fork dropped in finally. test/rehearse.test.ts: live world identical after rehearsal, fork absent from GRAPH.LIST, RehearsalDiff schema valid, and the rehearsal diff equals the diff of the real execution afterwards. Gates green.

agents/tools.ops.ts: lookup_order, update_address (restore_address), create_ticket (close_ticket), post_message (delete_message), send_email (irreversible, mitigation draft_correction_email), schedule_followup (cancel_event); reads/writes come from what each implementation touched. test/tools.ops.test.ts: one test per tool including its inverse/mitigation recorded and checked.
